problemStatement: Opening/increasing SELL Yes and SELL No trades are short token exposures whose economic event-side probability is the complement of raw token price, but current InsPoly reporting and several model signals use raw token price/outcome.

motivatingExample.market: Will the U.S. invade Iran before 2027?

classifications.summary: UI labels raw traded-token price as entry chance/probability.
Reports lack separate raw token price, raw token outcome, economic side, and economic-side probability fields.
Low-probability, later-correctness, and winner-rank paths use raw token price/outcome.
Opening SELL capital at risk currently uses raw trade notional instead of complement-side stake/liability.
Same-side clusters use raw side/outcome or non-normalized long/short token direction.
Opening SELL exposure is recognized as increase_short, and favorable repricing for SELL treats falling token price as favorable.

allowedChanges: Add additive raw/economic fields to raw_metrics and payload/export schemas
Clarify UI labels for token price versus economic probability
forbiddenChanges: Do not change _score_trade weights or thresholds
Do not change Strong Risk gates

candidateChanges: Use economicSide for later correctness and winner rank
Use economicSide for wallet winning opening entry counts
Add economicCapitalAtRisk while preserving raw trade notional
Assess opening SELL complement-side stake/liability from 1 - token price
Validate against Polymarket Data API accounting before using in gates or funding trace eligibility

currentBehaviorTests: opening SELL is classified as increase_short
BUY probability fields match raw token price
SELL repricing direction treats falling token price as favorable
phase1PassingContracts: SELL Yes exposes additive economic-side probability while price_implied_probability remains raw token price
SELL No exposes additive economic-side probability while price_implied_probability remains raw token price
UI labels raw token price separately from economic-side probability
expectedFailuresUntilPhase2OrLater: Low-probability flags should use economic probability
Same-side clustering should group economic equivalents
Old price_implied_probability should be replaced by economic probability only if a separately approved model/report migration changes the legacy field contract

invariantsToPreserve: _score_trade remains unchanged until explicit model-behavior approval
Old saved outputs are not mutated
recommendedNextPrompt: Implement Phase 1 only: add shared side/outcome normalization fields and clarify UI/report labels, while preserving _score_trade, Strong Risk gates, scoring weights, severity labels, HER routing, funding eligibility, candidate admission, and old saved outputs.
